title: CatchSlide: lecture slides, straightened the moment you shoot
description: Shoot a slide from any seat. CatchSlide finds its corners, flattens it as if seen head-on, files it by presentation and makes the text searchable.

problem.title: Ever opened your camera roll to revise and couldn't find the slide?
problem.text: Slides shot from the back row come out skewed, then get buried between selfies and receipts. In a quiet lecture hall, the shutter sound alone makes you hesitate. CatchSlide shoots silently, straightens every slide and keeps each talk together as one presentation.

features.title: Straight the moment you shoot
features.text:
The camera tracks the slide's four corners live and turns green when it has them. Even at an angle, the slide is flattened as if shot head-on, with the background cropped away.
No shutter sound. Turn on `Auto Capture` and it grabs each new slide as the speaker moves on, skipping shots that came out blurry.

features.title: Photos you already took, all at once
features.text:
Pick a batch of lecture photos in the Photos app and share them to CatchSlide. They're straightened and filed as one presentation, in the order you took them.
Turn on `Sharpen Text` to clear away shadows and washed-out contrast.

features.title: Find it with the one word you remember
features.text:
CatchSlide reads the text on every slide, right on your device. Weeks later, a single word brings that slide back.
Notes you add to a slide are searchable too. Tag a few with `exam` and the whole syllabus for the test is one search away.

items.q: How do I capture a slide?
items.a: Open the camera and frame the slide. When the corners turn green, tap the shutter. With auto capture on, it takes the next slide on its own each time the slide changes.

items.q: Does it make a shutter sound?
items.a: No. It saves the frame straight from the camera view, so it's silent in every country.

items.q: Why are my shots grouped into one presentation?
items.a: If you take the next shot within 5 minutes of the last one, it's treated as the same presentation. Tap a title in the list to rename it, and use `Merge Presentations` to join ones that were split up.

items.q: Can I add photos I already took?
items.a: Yes. Select photos in the Photos app and share them to CatchSlide, or tap ＋ in the list and choose `Import from Photos`. They're straightened and filed as one presentation in the order you took them.

Open the slide, then choose `Adjust Corners` from the ⋯ menu and drag the four corners into place. `Auto Detect` finds them again, and `Full Image` uses the whole photo. The original is always kept, so you can redo it anytime.

items.q: Can I search the text on my slides?
items.a: Type a word in the search field at the top of the list. It searches slide text, presentation titles, notes and transcripts, and jumps straight to the slide. Text recognition happens on your device.

items.q: How do I export a PDF?
items.a: In a presentation, open the share menu, choose `Export as PDF` and pick one, two or four slides per page. Save it to Files or send it to another app from the share sheet.

items.q: How do I reorder or delete slides?
items.a: In a presentation, press and hold a slide and drag it to reorder. The same long-press menu lets you delete or share one slide, and `Select` lets you delete several at once.

items.q: How do recording and AI summaries work?
items.a: Turn on `Record` at the top of the camera and each slide keeps the audio from that moment. In Deck Notes, `Summarize with AI` writes a summary from the slide text and transcripts. AI summaries need iOS 26 or later on a device that supports Apple Intelligence.

items.q: Where are my slides and recordings stored?
items.a: On your device. They go to your own iCloud only if you turn on `Sync` in My Info, and no account is needed. See the Privacy Policy for details.
